footnote_text: Represents shares of Common Stock purchased by the Reporting Person from GNK Holdings LLC in a privately negotiated transaction pursuant to a Stock Purchase Agreement, dated as of November 3, 2026, by and among Ezra Beyman, Mordechai Menachem Beyman, the Reporting Person and GNK Holdings LLC (the "Stock Purchase Agreement"), at a purchase price of $2.60 per share. The purchase closed on November 20, 2026, upon delivery of the shares to the Reporting Person and the release of the purchase price from escrow in accordance with the Stock Purchase Agreement. || The Reporting Person, Ezra Beyman and Mordechai Menachem Beyman may be deemed to be members of a "group" for purposes of Section 13(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), by reason of the Stock Purchase Agreement, and such group may be deemed to beneficially own an aggregate of 323,982 shares of Common Stock. The Reporting Person may be deemed a 10% owner of the Issuer solely by reason of such group membership. The Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares of Common Stock held by the other members of such group, except to the extent of any pecuniary interest therein, and this report shall not be deemed an admission that the Reporting Person is the beneficial owner of such shares for purposes of Section 16 of the Exchange Act or for any other purpose.
